mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) indicate an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5% indicates a severe labor market contraction that depresses consumer spending and corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts below their 12-month moving averages signals a deepening economic contraction that triggers aggressive policy responses, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST are below their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (GDPC1 growth rate negative), a deceleration in the rate of decline (i.e., quarterly GDP growth rate becomes less negative) signals the onset of economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth rate > prior QoQ growth rate
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth rate is higher than the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in total nonfarm employment below its 12-month moving average signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Deflationary pressures (CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate below 1.0%) indicate a severe economic contraction that increases the risk of a debt deflation spiral, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to a severe labor market crisis, which is followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO < 100), a rebound in industrial production above 100 signals the beginning of a manufacturing sector recovery, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
